task: Binary prediction of neuron segment connectivity from EM data features
input: 20 engineered features (morphology, intensity, embedding modalities) + degradation type
scientific_goal: Automate connectomics proofreading by predicting segment merge decisions
method_commitments: Train and compare multiple classifier architectures

Test set: 72,000 samples with identical structure
